name: Dark Sense
description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, when the Killer gets within 24 m of you, you see their Aura for 5 / 7 / 10 s.
"Slow down, don't rush and try not to worry so much! The best way to beat him is to know how he thinks." -Lost Tapes: Murf

name: Deja Vu
description: You see the Auras of the 3 Generators closest to each other and repair them 4 / 5 / 6 % faster.

name: Hope
description:
When all Generators are completed, you gain 3 / 4 / 5 % Haste .
"Buckle up, fuckos! Let's roll!" -Lost Tapes: Nikki

name: Lightweight
description:
Your Scratch Marks disappear 3 / 4 / 5 s faster and appear more spread out.
"Take it slow, he knows where you've been… just like I've always said: live slow and die old." -Lost Tapes: Dylan

name: No One Left Behind
description:
When all Generators are completed: You heal 50 / 75 / 100 % faster. You unhook other Survivors 50 / 75 / 100 % faster. Whenever you unhook a Survivor, they gain 10 % more Haste . You see the Auras of other Survivors.
“Yeah, no shit. But we can outsmart and overthrow him if we work together. Don't be predictable and selfish!” -Lost Tapes: Clyde

name: Plunderer's Instinct
description:
Within 32 / 48 / 64 m of locked Chests and dropped items, you see their Auras.
Whenever you unlock a Chest, you are 50 % more likely to find an item of higher rarity.
"The pioneers used to loot these babies for hours." -Lost Tapes: Aizeyu

name: Premonition
description:
While the Killer is within 36 m of you and inside a 45 degree cone, whenever you look at them, you hear a sound cue. Cooldown: 60 / 45 / 30 s.
"I have a bad feeling about this!"

name: Resilience
description:
While injured: You bless and cleanse Totems 3 / 6 / 9 % faster. You heal 3 / 6 / 9 % faster. You open Exit Gates 3 / 6 / 9 % faster. You repair 3 / 6 / 9 % faster. You sabotage Hooks 3 / 6 / 9 % faster. You unhook Survivors 3 / 6 / 9 % faster. You unlock chests 3 / 6 / 9 % faster. You vault 3 / 6 / 9 % faster.
"Focus, even in these desperate times."

name: Slippery Meat
description: You can attempt to unhook yourself up to 6 times and have 2 / 3 / 4 % more chance to succeed.

name: Small Game
description:
Within 8 / 10 / 12 m of you, whenever you look at a Totem in a 45 degree cone, you hear a sound cue. Cooldown: 14 / 12 / 10 s.
Whenever a Survivor cleanses a Totem, you earn 1 Token, up to 5 .
For each Token, the cone is 5 degrees smaller.
"Nope." -Lost Tapes: Andy

name: Spine Chill
description:
Within 36 m, whenever the Killer looks at you, you hear a sound cue.
Within 36 m, while the Killer is looking at you: You bless and cleanse Totems 2 / 4 / 6 % faster. You heal 2 / 4 / 6 % faster. You open Exit Gates 2 / 4 / 6 % faster. You repair Generators 2 / 4 / 6 % faster. You sabotage Hooks 2 / 4 / 6 % faster. You unhook Survivors 2 / 4 / 6 % faster. You unlock Chests 2 / 4 / 6 % faster.

name: This Is Not Happening
description: While injured, great basic Skill Check zones are 10 / 20 / 30 % bigger.

name: We'll make it
description:
Whenever you unhook a Survivor, for 30 / 60 / 90 s, you heal other Survivors 100 % faster.
"I'm confident we can all escape in one piece if we help each other."

name: Kindred
description:
While you are hooked, all Survivors see each others' Auras. While the Killer is within 8 / 12 / 16 m, all Survivors sees the Killer's Aura.
While another Survivor is hooked, you see the Auras of other Survivors. While the Killer is within 8 / 12 / 16 m of the hooked Survivor, you see the Killer's Aura.
“Be kind to one another. We're all in this together.” -Lost Tapes: Sujan

name: Bitter Murmur
description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, you see the Auras of Survivors within 16 m of it for 5 s.
When all Generators are completed, you see the Auras of all Survivors for 5 / 7 / 10 s.

name: Deerstalker
description:
Every 40 / 35 / 30 s, the Survivor with the least time in chase sees your Aura for 3 s.
While a Survivor sees your Aura, you see their Aura.

name: Distressing
description:
Your Terror Radius is 20 / 25 / 30 % larger.
"Bask in their fear."

name: Hex: No One Escapes Death
description:
When all Generators are completed, a Dull Totem ignites: Survivors gain Exposed . You gain 2 / 3 / 4 % Haste .
Within 4 m, Survivors see the Hex Totem's Aura, expanding to 24 m over 30 s.
"And the beast became faster and more powerful as if The Entity's shadowy whips were lashing at its back."

name: Insidious
description: After being idle for 3 / 2 / 1 s, you gain Undetectable until you act.

name: Iron Grasp
description: While carrying a Survivor: They wiggle 4 / 8 / 12 % slower. Their wiggle is 75 % weaker.

name: Scourge Hook: Monstrous Shrine
description:
When the trial starts: 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks. The Basement Hooks become Scourge Hooks.
While you are at least 24 m away from a Survivor on a Scourge Hook, they are sacrificed 10 / 15 / 20 % faster.
"Then you will know that there is no escape. When hanging in the depths, you face the dark one."

name: Sloppy Butcher
description:
Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic-attack: They gain Hemorrhage for 70 / 80 / 90 s. They gain Mangled for 70 / 80 / 90 s.
Survivors with Hemorrhage lose healing progress 25 % faster.
"It's in its sadistic nature. There is no swift kill as it delights in the obscene spectacle of our agonizing suffering."

name: Spies from the Shadows
description:
Whenever a Survivor scares a Crow within 20 / 28 / 36 m of you, you are alerted. Cooldown: 5 s.
"In the shadows they torment, scarring our minds with each scream."

name: Unrelenting
description: Whenever you miss a basic-attack, your cooldown is 20 / 25 / 30 % shorter.

name: Whispers
description:
While within 48 / 40 / 32 m of a Survivor, you randomly hear whispers.
"It's unclear as to the motivations of The Fog, but it is undeniable that it often takes the beast's side." -Notebook

name: Hex: Thrill of the Hunt
description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.
For each Dull and Hex Totem remaining, you have 1 Token.
For each Token, Survivors bless and cleanse totems 8 / 10 / 12 % slower.

name: Bond
description:
Within 20 / 28 / 36 m, you see other Survivors' Auras.
"We have to work as a team, I need you to survive so that I can survive!" -Dwight

name: Leader
description:
Within 10 m of you, other Survivors: Cleanse Totems 20 / 25 / 30 % faster. Heal 20 / 25 / 30 % faster. Open Exit Gates 20 / 25 / 30 % faster. Sabotage Hooks 20 / 25 / 30 % faster. Unhook Survivors 20 / 25 / 30 % faster. Unlock Chests 20 / 25 / 30 % faster.
After they leave your range, this ends after 20 s.

name: Prove Thyself
description:
For each other Survivor within 4 m of you, all Survivors repair 6 / 8 / 10 % faster.
"Show me what you can do!" -Dwight

name: Adrenaline
description: When all Generators are completed, if you are downed or injured, heal instantly. Then, ignoring Exhausted : You gain 50 % Haste for 3 s. You gain Exhausted for 60 / 50 / 40 s.

name: Quick & Quiet
description: You hide in Lockers and vault silently. The Killer is not alerted. Cooldown: 25 / 20 / 15 s.

name: Sprint Burst
description: Whenever you start running: You gain 50 % Haste for 3 s. You gain Exhausted for 60 / 50 / 40 s.

name: Botany Knowledge
description:
You heal 30 / 40 / 50 % faster.
"Basic botany knowledge could save your life someday." -Claudette Morel

name: Empathy
description: Within 64 / 96 / 128 m, you see the Auras of injured Survivors.

name: Self-Care
description: You can heal yourself, but 75 / 70 / 65 % slower.

name: Calm Spirit
description:
You do not scare Crows or scream.
You bless and cleanse Totems, and unlock Chests silently, but 40 / 35 / 30 % slower.

name: Iron Will
description: While injured and not Exhausted , your Grunts of Pain are 80 / 90 / 100 % quieter.

name: Saboteur
description:
Within 56 m of where another Survivor was picked-up by the Killer and is being carried, you see the Auras of Hooks and Scourge Hooks.
You can sabotage Hooks. Cooldown: 70 / 65 / 60 s.

name: Agitation
description:
While carrying a Survivor: You gain 6 / 12 / 18 % Haste . Your Terror Radius is 12 m larger.
"At some point, the excitement of hooking one of us becomes more important than the desire to kill us."

name: Brutal Strength
description:
You basic-break Pallets and Breakable Walls, and damage Generators 10 / 15 / 20 % faster.
"It's more than muscles. A dark power motivates the beast."

name: Unnerving Presence
description:
Survivors within your Terror Radius get 10 % more basic Skill Checks.
The good zone of basic Skill Checks is 40 / 50 / 60 % smaller.
"Its presence befalls us."

name: Bloodhound
description:
Pools of Blood are brighter and last 2 / 3 / 4 s longer.
"Pebbles shimmering in the moonlight; my life drips down in a trail so easy to follow."

name: Predator
description:
When you stop chasing a Survivor, you see their Aura for 4 s. Cooldown: 60 / 50 / 40 s.
"Never stop moving and hope you're always two steps ahead of the beast." -Notebook

name: Shadowborn
description:
Whenever you are blinded, gain 6 / 8 / 10 % Haste for 10 s.
"Shining in the darkest dark, his eyes pierce the night and sting your soul."

name: Enduring
description:
While not carrying a Survivor, Pallet-stuns are 40 / 45 / 50 % shorter.
"He stops at nothing."

name: Lightborn
description:
Whenever a Survivor attempts to blind you, you see their Aura for 6 / 8 / 10 s.
You cannot be blinded.
"These monsters… they adapt! They emerge with strange new abilities." -Vigo's Journal

name: Tinkerer
description:
The first time each Generator has 70 % progress: You gain Undetectable for 12 / 14 / 16 s. You are alerted.
"The Hillbilly makes impressive tools out of scraps. Tools aimed at maiming us in creative ways..." -Notebook

name: A Nurse's Calling
description:
Within 28 / 30 / 32 m of injured Survivors who are healing or being healed, you see their Auras.
“Still attached to the fragments of her past life, she is drawn to those in need of help.”

name: Stridor
description:
Survivors' breathing noises are 15 / 20 / 25 % louder and their Grunts of Pain are 30 / 40 / 50 % louder.
“If you don't stop and catch your breath… she will.”

name: Thanatophobia
description:
For each injured, downed, or hooked Survivor, all Survivors: Cleanse totems 1 / 1.5 / 2 % slower. Repair 1 / 1.5 / 2 % slower. Sabotage Hooks 1 / 1.5 / 2 % slower.
While 4 Survivors are either injured, downed or hooked, all above actions are additionally 12 % slower.
"She plays with us and revels in our pain."

name: Balanced Landing
description:
Whenener you fall from at least 1.25 m: You gain 50 % Haste for 3 s. You gain Exhausted for 60 / 50 / 40 s. Your stagger is 75 % shorter. Your Grunts from falling are 100 % quieter.
"I've jumped from higher places." -Nea

name: Streetwise
description:
The first time you deplete an Item's Charges, you see the Killer's Aura for 8 s.
Whenever you loot an item from a Chest, it has 60 / 70 / 80 % more Charges.
"You're doing it wrong! Let me show you how it's done." - Nea

name: Urban Evasion
description:
While crouched, you gain 90 / 95 / 100 % Haste .
"The paint is still fresh but I'm long gone." -Nea

name: Dying Light
description:
Whenever you hook a Survivor that is not the Obsession, earn 1 token.
While the Obsession is alive, for each Token: Other Survivors heal 2 / 2.5 / 3 % slower. Other Survivors repair 2 / 2.5 / 3 % slower. Other Survivors sabotage Hooks 2 / 2.5 / 3 % slower.
The Obsession: Heals other Survivors 33 % faster. Unhooks other Survivors 33 % faster.
"This isn't a man..." -Dr.Sam Loomis

name: Play With Your Food
description:
Whenever you stop chasing the Obsession, you earn 1 Token, up to 3 . Cooldown: 10 s.
For each Token, gain 3 / 4 / 5 % Haste .
Whenever you attack, lose 1 Token.
“You've fooled them, haven't you Michael? But not me.” -Dr. Sam Loomis

name: Save the best for last
description:
Whenever you damage a Survivor who is not the Obsession with a basic-attack, you earn 1 Token, up to 6 / 7 / 8 .
For each Token, your basic-attack cooldown are 4 % shorter.
Whenever the Obsession takes damage, lose 2 Tokens.
While the Obsession is dead, you cannot earn Tokens.
"Death has come to your little town, sheriff." -Dr. Sam Loomis

name: Decisive Strike
description:
Until all Generators are completed, whenever you are unhooked, for the next 40 / 50 / 60 s: when the Killer picks you up, once per trial, hit a Special Skill check: Stun the Killer for 4 s. Become the Obsession.
This is disabled by conspicuous actions. At the start of the trial, you are more likely to be the Obsession.
"There is nothing to be scared of." -Laurie Strode

name: Object of Obsession
description:
While you are the Obsession, every 30 s, the Killer sees your Aura for 3 s.
While the Killer sees your Aura: You see their Aura. You cleanse totems 2 / 4 / 6 % faster. You heal 2 / 4 / 6 % faster. You repair 2 / 4 / 6 % faster.
When the trial starts, you are more likely to be the Obsession.
“He was watching me!” -Laurie Strode

name: Sole Survivor
description:
Whenever a Survivor dies, you earn 1 Token.
For each Token, within 20 / 22 / 24 m, the Killer cannot see your Aura.
When all other Survivors are dead: You repair 75 % faster. You open Exit Gates and the Hatch 50 % faster.
When the trial starts, you are more likely to be the Obsession.
“It was the boogeyman.” -Laurie Strode

name: Hex: Devour Hope
description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.
Whenever a Survivor is unhooked while you are at least 24 m away, earn 1 Token, up to 5 : 2 Tokens | 10 s after hooking a Survivor, gain 3 / 4 / 5 % Haste for 10 s. 3 Tokens | Survivors gain Exposed . 5 Tokens | You can Kill downed Survivors.
“If you do nothing, you have their blood on your hands. If you save them, her hunger grows.“

name: Hex: Ruin
description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.
While a Generator is not being repaired, it regresses at 100 / 125 / 150 % speed.
“A curse is upon you. It will be your ruin.”

name: Hex: The Third Seal
description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.
Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic or special-attack, they gain Blindness .
This applies for up to 2 / 3 / 4 Survivors.
“She touched your skin, you bear the witch's mark!”

name: Ace in the Hole
description:
Whenever you loot an item from a Chest, it will have: A Visceral or lower rarity add-on. 50 / 75 / 100 % chance for an Uncommon or lower rarity add-on.
When you escape, you keep your add-ons.
“Everything that glitters isn't gold. But gold isn't worth a damn in this place, so this should come in handy.” -Ace

name: Open-Handed
description:
All Survivors see Auras that have a range from 8 / 12 / 16 m farther.
“Paying attention is what kept me alive through the years. That, and my good looks of course.” -Ace

name: Up the Ante
description:
For each other Survivor alive, all Survivors are 1 / 2 / 3 % luckier.
All Survivors can attempt to unhook themselves.
“What can I say? I'm just a very lucky guy… I'm sure some of it will rub off on you.” -Ace

name: Borrowed Time
description:
Whenever you unhook a Survivor: They retain their unhook Endurance for 6 / 8 / 10 s longer. They retain their unhook Haste for 10 s longer.
"Probably stings like hell, but it ain't gonna kill ya. Up and at 'em soldier. Time to move!" -Bill Overbeck

name: Left Behind
description:
When all other Survivors are dead, while within 24 / 28 / 32 m of the Hatch, you see it's Aura.
"I'm not horseshittin' around. I'm doing this alone!" -Bill

name: Unbreakable
description:
Once per trial, while downed by the Killer, you can fully recover.
While downed, you recover 25 / 30 / 35 % faster.
"Goddammit, I am seriously FUBAR!" -Bill

name: Overcharge
description:
Whenever you damage a Generator: Its regression speed will go from 85 % to 130 % over the next 30 s. The next Survivor who starts repairing it gets a special Skill Check. If they miss it, they lose 2 / 3 / 4 % more progress.
"It is a trap. But a trap one must step in…" -The Doctor

name: Monitor & Abuse
description:
While chasing a Survivor, your Terror Radius is 5 / 10 / 15 % bigger.
While not chasing a Survivor, your Terror Radius is 15 / 20 / 25 % smaller.
"It's time for your treatment!" -The Doctor

name: Overwhelming Presence
description:
Whenever a Survivor uses an item within 32 m of you, they gain Exhausted for 15 s.
Whenever a Survivor within 32 m of you gains Exhausted , you see the closest Exhausted Survivor's Aura for 2 / 3 / 4 s. Cooldown: 25 s.
"Shit!! I dropped the gauze!"

name: Alert
description:
Whenever the Killer breaks a Pallet or Breakable Wall, or damages a Generator: You hear a sound cue. You see their Aura for 3 / 4 / 5 s.
“I have true sight.” -Feng Min

name: Lithe
description:
Whenever you medium or fast-vault: You gain 50 % Haste for 3 s. You gain Exhausted for 60 / 50 / 40 s.
“U mad?” -Feng Min

name: Technician
description:
While repairing a Generator: The range of Generator repair noises is 8 m shorter. Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, the Generator does not explode, but loses 5 / 4 / 3 % more progress.
“I'm gonna stealth this one.” -Feng Min

name: Beast of Prey
description:
Whenever you gain Bloodlust, gain Undetectable for 30 / 35 / 40 s.
"Where did she go?"

name: Hex: Huntress Lullaby
description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.
Whenever you hook a Survivor, earn 1 Token. For each Token, Basic Skill Check warnings appear later and good success zones are smaller.
While you have 5 Tokens, Basic Skill Check warnings don't appear.
Whenever a Survivor misses a basic Skill Check, they lose 2 / 4 / 6 % more progress.

name: Territorial Imperative
description: Whenever a Survivor enters the Basement while you are 24 m away from it, you see their Aura for 4 / 5 / 6 s. Cooldown: 45 s.

name: Dead Hard
description:
Whenever you are unhooked, while injured and running, use Active Ability Button 1 : You gain Endurance for 0.5 s. You gain Exhausted for 60 / 50 / 40 s.
“I thought to myself, ‘Gonna 'ave some fun ‘ere lads, let's get stuck in!' It were a right dust up, I swear down!” -David King

name: No Mither
description:
When the trial starts, you become injured, then: You gain Broken . Your Grunts of Pain are 100 % quieter. You leave no Pools of Blood. You recover 15 / 20 / 25 % faster. You can fully recover.
“I lost it and lamped him one. Had a few pints afterwards, moved on. Couldn't be mithered with it. Can't be arsed.” -David King

name: We're Gonna Live Forever
description:
You heal downed Survivors 100 % faster.
Whenever you finish healing a downed Survivor, they gain Endurance for 6 / 8 / 10 s. Cooldown: 30 s.
“Come on then, let's ‘ave it! I don't give a shit pal.” -David King

name: Barbecue & Chili
description:
Whenever you hook a Survivor, for 5 s, you see the Auras of all Survivors who are at least 60 / 50 / 40 m away from the hooked Survivor.
"I just can't take no pleasure in killing. There's just some things you gotta do. Don't mean you have to like it." -Drayton Sawyer

name: Franklin's Demise
description:
Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic attack, they drop their item.
Within 32 / 48 / 64 m, you see the Auras of dropped items.
"Sally, I hear something. Stop! Stop!" - Franklin

name: Knock Out
description:
Whenever a Survivor drops a Pallet, for the next 6 s, if they move 6 m away from it, they gain 5 % Hindered for 3 / 4 / 5 s.
"Oh, that gun's no good. The old way… with a sledge! You see, that way's better. They die better that way." -Nubbins Sawyer

name: Blood Warden
description:
When an Exit Gate is opened, once per trial, when you hook a Survivor, both Exits are blocked for 40 / 50 / 60 s.
You see the Auras of Survivors within Exit Thresholds.
“This is my world. And you can't ever leave.” - Freddy Krueger

name: Fire Up
description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, earn 1 Token, up to 5 .
For each Token: You basic-break Pallets and Breakable Walls 4 / 5 / 6 % faster. You damage Generators 4 / 5 / 6 % faster. You pick-up and drop Survivors 4 / 5 / 6 % faster. You basic-vault Windows 4 / 5 / 6 % faster.
“Now why don't you just fucking die?” - Freddy Krueger

name: Remember Me
description:
Whenever the Obsession takes damage, you earn 1 Token, up to 3 / 4 / 5 .
For each Token, Survivors who are not the Obsession open Exit Gates 30 % slower.
“You don't remember? You must. You're my number one, and you'll never wake up again.” - Freddy Krueger

name: Pharmacy
description:
Whenever you unlock a Chest, it will contain a rare Med-Kit.
You unlock Chests 75 / 100 / 125 % faster.
The range at which the Killer hears you unlocking Chests is 12 m shorter.

name: Vigil
description:
All Survivors within 16 m of you: Lose Blindness 44 / 55 / 66 % faster. Lose Broken 44 / 55 / 66 % faster. Lose Exhausted 44 / 55 / 66 % faster. Lose Exposed 44 / 55 / 66 % faster. Lose Hemorrhage 44 / 55 / 66 % faster. Lose Hindered 44 / 55 / 66 % faster. Lose Mangled 44 / 55 / 66 % faster. Lose Oblivious 44 / 55 / 66 % faster.
After they leave your range, this ends after 15 s.
"I'm gonna be here when you wake up. You're gonna make it." -Quentin Smith

name: Wake Up!
description: When all Generators are completed: You see the Auras of Exit Gate Switches. While opening an Exit Gate, other Survivors see your Aura. For each Survivor alive, you open Exit Gates 8 / 10 / 12.5 % faster.

name: Scourge Hook: Hangman's Trick
description:
When the trial starts, 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.
While carrying a Survivor, you see the Auras of Survivors within 12 / 14 / 16 m of Scourge Hooks.
Whenever a Survivor starts sabotaging a Hook, you are alerted.
"No excuses, no equivocations… No crying." -Amanda Young

name: Make your Choice
description:
When a Survivor rescues another from a hook at least 32 meters away from you, Make your Choice causes the Survivor to scream and applies the Exposed status effect to them for 40 / 50 / 60 seconds .
Make your Choice has a cooldown of 40 / 50 / 60 seconds .
Exposed Survivors will be downed by basic attacks even if uninjured.
"You'd be surprised what tools can save a life." -Amanda Young

name: Surveillance
description:
You see the Auras of regressing Generators.
Whenever a Generator stops regressing, you see its Aura for 8 / 12 / 16 s.
Generator repair noises can be heard from 8 m farther away.
"Are you gonna behave?" -Amanda Young

name: Detective's Hunch
description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, for 20 s, within 32 / 48 / 64 m of you: You see the Auras of Chests. You see the Auras of Generators. You see the Auras of Totems.
"Are you able to tell us where you were last night?" -Detective David Tapp

name: Stake Out
description:
After hiding for 15 s within the Killer's Terror Radius, you earn 1 Token, up to 2 / 3 / 4 .
Whenever you hit a good basic Skill Check, spend 1 Token: The good Skill Check becomes a great Skill Check. You gain 1 % more progress.
"I had you, I had you on your knees. You're runnin' scared because we had you. We're gonna close this case!" -Detective David Tapp

name: Tenacity
description:
While downed: You gain 30 / 40 / 50 % Haste . You can crawl and recover at the same time. Your Grunts of Pain are 75 % quieter.
"What the hell is this? I'm taking this bastard down!" -Detective David Tapp

name: Bamboozle
description:
Whenever you vault a Window, it is blocked for Survivors for 8 / 12 / 16 s.
You basic-vault Windows 5 / 10 / 15 % faster.
Only 1 Window can be blocked at a time.

name: Coulrophobia
description: Survivors within your Terror Radius: Heal 30 / 40 / 50 % slower. While healing, basic Skill Checks spin 50 % faster.

name: Pop Goes the Weasel
description: Whenever you hook a Survivor, for the next 35 / 40 / 45 s, when you damage a Generator, it explodes and loses 15 % more progress.

name: Boil Over
description:
While carried by the Killer: Whenever the Killer falls from at least 1.25 m, you gain 33 % of your current wiggle progress. Your wiggle is 60 / 70 / 80 % stronger. Within 16 m, the Killer cannot see Hook Auras.
“Buck and Wild/ Swing to be free/Your hands just can't keep ahold of me.” -Kate Denson's Boil Over

name: Dance With Me
description:
Whenever you fast-exit a Locker, medium-vault, or fast-vault, you leave no Scratch Marks for 5 s. Cooldown: 25 / 20 / 15 s.
“Dance with me, there's a storm comin'/Follow my boots, try to keep up/Dance with me, until sun up.” -Kate Denson's Dance With Me

name: Windows of Opportunity
description:
Within 24 / 28 / 32 m of you: You see the Auras of Pallets. You see the Auras of Breakable Walls. You see the Auras of Windows.
“Carve your name/Value faith an' family, don't complain/Open your windows of opportunity.” -Kate Denson's Windows of Opportunity

name: Hex: Haunted Ground
description:
When the trial starts, 2 Dull Totems ignite.
When either of those Hex Totems is blessed or cleansed: All Survivors gain Exposed for 40 / 50 / 60 s. The other Totem is extinguished.
“Her home became profane.”

name: Rancor
description:
Whenever a Generator is completed: You are alerted to the position of all Survivors for 3 s. The Obsession sees your Aura for 5 / 4 / 3 s.
When all Generators are completed: The Obsession gains Exposed . You can Kill the Obsession.

name: Spirit Fury
description:
After you break 4 / 3 / 2 Pallets, when you are Pallet-stunned, the Pallet is destroyed.
“Fury is her blood.”

name: Autodidact
description:
You start the trial with 0 Tokens, up to 3 / 4 / 5 , and your good basic healing Skill Checks give 15 % less progress.
While healing another Survivor without a Med-Kit: Whenever you hit a basic Skill Check, you earn 1 token. Whenever you hit a basic Skill Check, for each Token, you gain 15 % more progress. You cannot get great basic Skill Checks.
“There's no limit to what you can achieve, as long as you back it up with hard work.” -Adam Francis

name: Deliverance
description:
Once per trial, when you safely unhook another Survivor, you can unhook yourself. When you unhook yourself this way, you gain Broken for 100 / 80 / 60 s.
“I was raised by a strict man who taught me how to make the best of a bad situation.” -Adam Francis

name: Diversion
description:
After hiding for 30 / 25 / 20 s within the Killer's Terror Radius, while crouched and idle, use Active Ability Button 1 to throw a pebble 20 m away: The Killer is alerted. The pebble leaves Scratch Marks.
“There's what is easy and then there's what is right. If you confuse the two, there's no telling what you become.” -Adam Francis

name: Discordance
description:
Within 64 / 96 / 128 m of you, whenever a Generator is being repaired by at least 2 Survivors, you are alerted.
While that Generator is being repaired by at least 2 Survivors, you see its Aura. When it is no longer being repaired by at least 2 Survivors, this ends after 4 s.
"Smartasses get killed. We always see to that." -The Legion

name: Iron Maiden
description:
Whenever a Survivor exits a Locker: They gain Exposed for 30 s. They scream, then you are alerted to their location for 4 s.
You open Lockers 30 / 40 / 50 % faster.
“This is no place for cowards.” -The Legion

name: Mad Grit
description:
While carrying a Survivor: Whenever you miss a basic attack, your cooldown is 100 % shorter. Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic attack, the carried Survivor gains no wiggle progress for 2 / 3 / 4 s.
“There's no getting out of this now. We're too good at it.” -The Legion

name: Aftercare
description:
You and up to 1 / 2 / 3 Survivors see each other's Auras whenever: You unhook them, or they unhook you. You finish healing them, or they finish healing you.
This effect lasts until you are hooked.
“Oil work to honor my best buddies, the best musicians I know. Their album got me through dark times.” –Jeff, oil on canvas, 16x16

name: Breakdown
description:
Whenever you are unhooked: The Hook breaks, then is repaired after 180 s. You see the Killer's Aura for 4 / 5 / 6 s.
“Named Belly of the Beast, this wood piece had a story to tell; it didn't waste its second chance.” –Jeff (ink & oil wash on wood)

name: Distortion
description:
When the trial starts, and after being chased for 15 s, you earn 1 Token, up to 2 .
While not downed, whenever the Killer attempts to see your Aura, spend 1 Token. Then, for the next 8 / 10 / 12 s: The Killer cannot see your Aura. You leave no Scratch Marks.
“Exploration of Norse mythology: bravery can conceal your flaws, even at your most vulnerable.” –Jeff, pencil on toned paper

name: Corrupt Intervention
description:
When the trial starts, the 3 farthest Generators from you are blocked for 80 / 100 / 120 s, or until you down a Survivor.
“It shall be known across the land that the Gods curse the unfaithful.” (The Tablet of Adiris, 3.7.)

name: Dark Devotion
description:
Whenever the Obsession takes damage, for 35 / 40 / 45 s: Your Terror Radius is set to 40 m. The Obsession has your Terror Radius. You gain Undetectable .
“And terror shall take hold of a defiant non-believer, who shall falsely announce my arrival.” (The Tablet of Adiris, 48.9)

name: Infectious Fright
description:
Whenever a Survivor is downed, Survivors within your Terror Radius scream and you are alerted for 4 / 5 / 6 s.
“Horror overcomes the heart of infidels who cry at the feet of the fallen.” (Hymn of Praise, 11. 4)

name: Head On
description:
After hiding in a Locker for 3 s, fast-exit to stun the Killer for 3 s if they are within 2.5 m, then gain Exhausted for 60 / 50 / 40 s.
“People are remembered for what they overcome. You run or you face your fears and remind the world who you are.” –Jane Romero

name: Poised
description:
The first time you start repairing each Generator, you see the Killer's Aura for 8 s.
Whenever a Generator is completed, you leave no Scratch Marks for 20 / 25 / 30 s.
“Ok, stay calm. Don't overthink it and just keep moving forward: you got this.” -Jane Romero

name: Solidarity
description:
While injured and healing another Survivor without a Med-Kit, you also gain healing progress at 50 / 60 / 70 % speed.
“Showing up when things get rough and supporting those in need; that's how you become stronger, that's how you grow.” –Jane Romero

name: Buckle Up
description:
While healing a downed Survivor, you both see the Killer's Aura.
Whenever you finish healing a downed Survivor or fully recover: The Survivor gains 50 % Haste for 3 / 4 / 5 s. The Survivor leaves no Scratch Marks for 3 / 4 / 5 s.
“Ghost beaters never leave a man behind." -Ash Williams

name: Flip-Flop
description:
While downed, whenever the Killer picks you up, 50 % of your recovery progress is added to your wiggle progress, up to 40 / 45 / 50 %.
"Catch ya on the flip-flop." -Ash Williams

name: Mettle of Man
description:
After taking 3 protection hits, while injured and until you go down, the next time you would be downed by the Killer, take no damage instead.
When you become healthy, while you are at least 12 / 14 / 16 m from the Killer, they see your Aura.
When the trial starts, you are more likely to be the Obsession.
"Evil has a bullseye on my back the size of Tiger Stadium." -Ash Williams

name: Furtive Chase
description:
Whenever you hook the Obsession: You gain 10 % Haste for 14 / 16 / 18 s. You gain Undetectable for 14 / 16 / 18 s.
Whenever the Obsession is unhooked, the Survivor who unhooked them becomes the Obsession.
"You have no idea what I have planned for you. It'll be in the news for weeks: I'll make sure of it." –The Ghost Face

name: I'm All Ears
description:
Whenever a Survivor fast-enters or fast-exits a Locker, or medium or fast-vaults within 48 m of you, you see their Aura for 8 s. Cooldown: 60 / 45 / 30 s.
“There is no need to worry. I've been preparing my whole life for this." –The Ghost Face

name: Thrilling Tremors
description:
Whenever you pick-up a Survivor, all Generators not being repaired are blocked for 16 s. Cooldown: 40 / 35 / 30 s.
"The night assists me and it's endless here." -The Ghost Face

name: Cruel Limits
description:
Whenever a Generator is completed: You see the Auras of all Windows for 20 / 25 / 30 s. All Windows are blocked for Survivors for 20 / 25 / 30 s.
“The specimen seems to be able to perform some kind of telekinesis that impacts the state of nearby objects, as if they existed in some other form within a dimension alternate to our own.” -Hawkins National Laboratory

name: Mindbreaker
description:
While Survivors are repairing a Generator: They gain Blindness . They gain Exhausted .
When they stop repairing a Generator, this ends after 3 / 4 / 5 s.
"The specimen's apparent telepathic ability can evoke feelings of dread and fatigue in nearby individuals." -Hawkins National Laboratory

name: Surge
description:
Whenever you down a Survivor with a basic-attack, Generators within 32 m: Explode, lose 6 / 7 / 8 % progress and start regressing. Survivor repairing them scream.
“The creature appears to have some unknown influence over electricity and nearby electronics.” -Hawkins National Laboratory

name: Better Together
description:
While you are repairing a Generator: Other Survivors see that Generator's Aura. Whenever the Killer downs a Survivor, you see the Auras of all Survivors for 20 / 25 / 30 s.
“Let's burn that lab to the ground.” -Nancy Wheeler

name: Fixated
description:
While walking, you gain 10 / 15 / 20 % Haste .
You see your own Scratch Marks.
"I wanna finish what we started. I want to kill it." -Nancy Wheeler

name: Inner Strength
description:
Whenever you cleanse a Totem, while injured and not Broken , after hiding in a Locker for 10 / 9 / 8 s, you become healthy instantly.
“All this time I've been trying so hard to pretend like everything's fine, but it's not.” -Nancy Wheeler

name: Babysitter
description:
Whenever you unhook a Survivor: They gain 10 % Haste for 20 / 25 / 30 s. They leave no Pools of Blood for 20 / 25 / 30 s. They leave no Scratch Marks for 20 / 25 / 30 s. You see the Killer's Aura for 8 s.
“I promised to keep you shitheads safe, and that's exactly what I plan on doing.” -Steve Harrington

name: Camaraderie
description:
While you are struggling on Hook, when another Survivor gets within 16 m, the timer is paused for 26 / 30 / 34 s.
"So, remember once you get in there… pretend like you don't care. There you go, you're learning my friend. You're learning.” -Steve Harrington

name: Second Wind
description:
After you heal 1 Survivor, while not Broken , when you are unhooked, you gain Broken .
After 28 / 24 / 20 s, if you are not downed, you are instantly healed.
"Yeah, that's a no." -Steve Harrington

name: Blood Echo
description:
Whenever you hook a Survivor, for 20 / 25 / 30 s, all injured Survivors: Gain Exhausted . Gain Hemorrhage .
“Attack an enemy with precision and their allies will feel it.” -Renjiro's Doctrine 6:3

name: Nemesis
description:
Whenever a Survivor blinds you, Locker-stuns or Pallet-stuns you, they become the Obsession.
Whenever a Survivor becomes the Obsession: They gain Oblivious for 40 / 50 / 60 s. You see their Aura for 8 s.
“Only a fool would spit in a demon's face and declare victory.” -Renjiro's Doctrine 4:9

name: Zanshin Tactics
description:
Within 32 m, you see the Auras of Pallets and windows.
Whenever a Survivor drops a Pallet, you see their Aura for 3 / 4 / 5 s.
“Within your enemy's strength is weakness.” -Renjiro's Doctrine 12:5

name: Any Means Necessary
description:
While next to a Dropped Pallet, use Active Ability Button 1 for 5 / 4 / 3 s to reset it.
You see the Auras of Dropped Pallets.
“I'll hit you with everything I've got. Then I'll do it again.” -Yui Kimura

name: Breakout
description:
Within 5 m of a carried Survivor: You gain 6 / 8 / 10 % Haste . The carried Survivor wiggles 25 % faster.
“Come, we're going to rip our way out of this.” -Yui Kimura

name: Lucky Break
description:
While injured, for up to 40 / 50 / 60 s: You leave no Pools of Blood. You leave no Scratch Marks.
For each second spent healing another Survivor, recharge the duration by 1 s.
“That's not enough to beat me. Not even close.” -Yui Kimura

name: Dead Man's Switch
description:
After hooking a Survivor, *Dead Man's Switch* activates:
* **Blocks** the first Generator any Survivor stops repairing for **40**/**45**/**50** **seconds**.
* The *Blocked Generator* is highlighted to you in **white**.
*Dead Man's Switch* cannot activate if its effect is still active from a previous activation.
*"I've seen the look on a man's face when he realises he's going to die." — Caleb Quinn*

name: Gearhead
description:
Whenever a Survivor takes damage, for the next 30 s, whenever a Survivor repairing a Generator hits a good basic Skill Check, you see their Aura for 6 / 7 / 8 s.
"Sometimes a man's best work is what puts him in the grave." -The prison warden

name: Hex: Retribution
description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.
Whenever a Survivor starts blessing or cleansing a Totem, they gain Oblivious for 40 / 50 / 60 s.
Whenever a Hex Totem is blessed or cleansed, you see the Auras of all Survivors for 20 s.
"Bloody fool, you pulled the trigger on yourself." -Caleb Quinn

name: For the People
description:
While healthy and healing another Survivor without a Med-Kit, use Active Ability Button 1 to heal them instantly: You take damage. You gain Broken for 80 / 70 / 60 s. You become the Obsession.
When the trial starts, you are less likely to be the Obsession.
"We can write our own story and decide how it really ends." -Zarina Kassir

name: Off the Record
description:
Until all Generators are completed, whenever you are unhooked, for the next 30 / 35 / 40 s: You gain Endurance . Your Grunts of Pain are 100 % quieter. The Killer cannot see your Aura.
"Trust me, I investigate thoroughly and discreetly." -Zarina Kassir

name: Red Herring
description:
After you repair a Generator for at least 1 s, you see its Aura.
When you hide in a Locker, the Killer is alerted to the Generator. Cooldown: 25 / 20 / 15 s.
"The news edits out what is burdensome and complex, which is the truth." -Zarina Kassir

name: Deathbound
description: Whenever a Survivor finishes healing another, they scream. Then, until they take damage, while they are at least 12 / 8 / 4 m away from that Survivor: They gain Oblivious . They see that Survivor's Aura.

name: Forced Penance
description: Whenever a Survivor takes a protection hit, they gain Broken for 60 / 70 / 80 s.

name: Trail of Torment
description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, until it stops regressing: You gain undetectable . Survivors see that Generator's Aura.
Cooldown: 60 / 45 / 30 s.

name: Blood Pact
description:
While you are not the Obsession: While you or the Obsession are injured, you see each other's Auras. Whenever you finish healing the Obsession, or they finish healing you, while within 16 m of each other, you both gain 5 / 6 / 7 % Haste .
When the trial starts, you are less likely to be the Obsession.

name: Repressed Alliance
description:
You are accustomed to being hunted by malicious forces, and you have begun using it to your advantage.
After repairing Generators for a total of **55**/**50**/**45** **seconds**, *Repressed Alliance* activates:
* Press the *Active Ability button* to call upon The Entity to block the Generator you are currently repairing for **30 seconds**, after which *Repressed Alliance* deactivates.
* The Aura of the blocked Generator is revealed to all Survivors in **white**.
*Repressed Alliance* can only be triggered when no other Survivors are repairing your Generator.

name: Soul Guard
description:
While hexed, you can fully recover.
Whenever you fully recover, you gain Endurance for 4 / 6 / 8 s. Cooldown: 30 s.

name: Dragon's Grip
description:
Performing the *Damage Generator* action on a Generator activates *Dragon's Grip* for the next **30 seconds**:
* The first Survivor interacting with the damaged **Generator** will scream, revealing their location for **4 seconds**, and suffer from the ***Exposed*** **Status Effect** for **60 seconds**.
*Dragon's Grip* has a cool-down of **60**/**50**/**40** **seconds**.
*"Such potential in this compound... even the slightest trace causes unnatural effects." — Journal of Talbot Grimes*

name: Hex: Blood Favor
description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.
Whenever you damage a Survivor, Upright Pallets within 24 / 28 / 32 m of them are blocked for 15 s.
“It would be no leap of the imagination to suggest that the trials are a biological response of sorts.” -Journal of Talbot Grimes

name: Hex: Undying
description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.
When another Hex Totem is blessed or cleansed, it replaces this one and keeps any Tokens it had.
You see the Auras of Survivors within 2 / 3 / 4 m of Dull Totems.

name: Built to Last
description:
While holding a depleted item, after hiding in a Locker for 14 / 12 / 10 s, it is recharged to 99 %.
Each time you recharge an item this way, it recharges 33 % fewer Charges.
"Architecture is the soul of civilization.” -Felix Richter

name: Desperate Measures
description:
For each injured, downed, or hooked Survivor: You heal 16 / 18 / 20 % faster. You unhook 16 / 18 / 20 % faster.
"When they come with a wrecking ball, build stronger walls.” -Felix Richter

name: Visionary
description:
Within 32 m of you, you see the Auras of Generators.
Whenever a Generator is completed, cooldown: 20 / 18 / 16 s.

name: Hoarder
description:
When the trial starts, 2 more Chests appear.
Whenever a Survivor picks-up an item or starts unlocking a Chest within 32 / 48 / 64 m of you, you are alerted.

name: Oppression
description: Whenever you damage a Generator, up to 4 other Generators start regressing. Survivors repairing them get a special Skill Check. Cooldown: 45 / 40 / 35 s.

name: Coup de Grâce
description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, you earn 2 Tokens, up to 5 .
Whenever you lunge-attack, spend 1 Token to make it 70 / 75 / 80 % longer.

name: Appraisal
description:
When the trial starts, you earn 4 Tokens.
Spend 1 Token to rummage an empty Chest, up to 2 times per Chest.
You rummage Chests 40 / 60 / 80 % faster.

name: Deception
description:
Whenever you attempt to fast-enter a Locker: You do not enter the Locker. The Killer is alerted. You leave no Pools of Blood for 5 s. You leave no Scratch Marks for 5 s.
Cooldown: 25 / 20 / 15 s.

name: Power Struggle
description:
While carried by the Killer, while you have at least 25 / 20 / 15 % wiggle and next to an Upright Pallet, you can drop it to stun the Killer.
While downed, you see the Auras of Upright Pallets.
“I relied on others to protect me once and I lost everything. Never again.” -Élodie Rakoto

name: Starstruck
description:
While carrying a Survivor, Survivors within your Terror Radius gain Exposed . This ends 26 / 28 / 30 s after: They leave your Terror Radius. You drop or hook the carried Survivor.
Cooldown: 60 s.
"Enjoy this moment, few get so close." -Hak Ji-woon

name: Hex: Crowd Control
description:
The first time a Survivor medium or fast-vaults a Window, a Dull Totem ignites.
The last 4 / 5 / 6 Windows Survivors medium or fast-vault are blocked.
You basic-vault blocked Windows 15 % faster.
You see the Auras of blocked Windows within 24 m.
"You have no control. People like you never did." -Hak Ji-woon

name: No Way Out
description:
The first time you hook each Survivor, you earn 1 Token.
When all Generators are completed, when a Survivor starts opening an Exit Gate: It is blocked 12 s, plus 6 / 9 / 12 s for each Token. You are alerted.
"That sound when you bleed...let me hear it again." -Hak Ji-woon

name: Fast Track
description:
Whenever you unhook another Survivor, you earn 1 Token, up to 1 / 2 / 3 .
While repairing, whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, spend all Tokens. For each Token spent, the Generator gains 5 % permanent progress.
"The weak are sacrificed first. It's nature, it's business... it's the truth most refuse to face." -Yun-jin

name: Smash Hit
description:
Whenever you Pallet-stun the Killer: You gain 50 % Haste for 4 s. You gain Exhausted for 30 / 25 / 20 s.
"I've dealt with psychopaths in suits. You're just uglier and worse dressed." -Yun-jin

name: Self-Preservation
description:
Whenever another Survivor is hooked, you gain Elusive for 20 / 25 / 30 s.
"Something I learned in the industry: when the axe is swinging, keep your head down." -Yun-jin

name: Lethal Pursuer
description:
When the trial starts, you see the Auras of all Survivors for 7 / 8 / 9 s.
Whenever you see a Survivor's Aura for a duration, it is 2 s longer.
"...it knows what it wants and won't stop till it gets it." -Carlos Oliveira

name: Hysteria
description:
Whenever a healthy Survivor becomes injured, all injured Survivors gain Oblivious for 30 / 35 / 40 s. Cooldown: 20 s.
"Sorry I got a little jumpy there. Didn't know quite what to expect." -Robert Kendo

name: Eruption
description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, when you down a Survivor, all Generators damaged this way: Explode, lose 10 % progress and start regressing. Survivors repairing them scream, then you see their Auras for 8 / 10 / 12 s.
Cooldown: 30 s.
"It can use weapons?" -Jill Valentine

name: Counterforce
description:
When the trial starts, you earn 1 Token.
Whenever you cleanse a Totem, earn 1 Token, then, you see the Aura of the farthest Totem for 10 / 12 / 14 s.
For each Token, you cleanse Totems 25 % faster.
"I don't mind a little detective work." -Jill Valentine

name: Resurgence
description:
Whenever you are unhooked, you gain 50 / 60 / 70 % healing progress.
"It's my turn, bitch." -Jill Valentine

name: Blast Mine
description:
After repairing 40 % of Generators, while next to a Generator, use Active Ability Button 2 to trap it for 100 / 110 / 120 s. All Survivors see that Generator's Aura for that time.
When the Killer damages that Generator, the trap explodes, then: They are stunned for 4 s. Everyone nearby looking at the detonation is blinded.
"You want S.T.A.R.S.? I'll give you S.T.A.R.S.! " -Jill Valentine

name: Bite the Bullet
description:
While healing, you and the healed Survivor make no noises or Grunts of Pain. Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check: You lose only 3 / 2 / 1 % progress. The Killer is not alerted.
"I can do this." -Leon S. Kennedy

name: Flashbang
description:
After repairing 50 / 45 / 40 % of Generators, while hiding in a Locker, use Active Ability Button 1 to craft a Flashbang.
When you use the Flashbang: Everyone nearby looking at the detonation is blinded. The Killer is alerted.
"Get outta my face!" -Leon S. Kennedy

name: Rookie Spirit
description:
After you hit 5 / 4 / 3 basic repair Skill Checks, while a Generator is regressing, you see its Aura.
"I'll stop this, lieutenant. I promise." -Leon S. Kennedy

name: Deadlock
description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, the Generator with the most progress is blocked for 15 / 20 / 25 s.
"Nobody escapes us." -Pinhead

name: Hex: Plaything
description:
The first time you hook each Survivor, they are hexed and a Dull Totem ignites.
For 90 s, the Hex Totem is blocked to other Survivors.
The hexed Survivors:
Gain Oblivious . Within 24 / 20 / 16 m of the Hex totem, they see it's Aura.
"We came. Now you must come with us. Taste our pleasures." -Pinhead

name: Scourge Hook: Gift of Pain
description:
When the trial starts, 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.
Whenever a Survivor is unhooked from a Scourge Hook: They gain Hemorrhage for 90 s. They gain Mangled for 90 s. When they are healed, until they take damage, they heal and repair 10 / 13 / 16 % slower.
"We'll tear your soul apart." -Pinhead

name: Clairvoyance
description:
Whenever you bless or cleanse a Totem, while not holding an item, use {Input.UseItem} to, for up to 10 / 11 / 12 s and within 64 m: See the Auras of Chests. See the Auras of Exit Gate Switches. See the Auras of Generators. See the Aura of the Hatch. See the Auras of Hooks.
"Does anyone else see that? Just me?" -Mikaela Reid

name: Boon: Circle of Healing
description:
While next to a totem, use Active Ability Button 1 to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all your Boons.
Survivors within the Boon's range: While healing without a Med-Kit, they heal others 50 / 75 / 100 % faster. While injured, other Survivors see their Aura.
"Try this, it's better than anything you'll find in a pharmacy." -Mikaela Reid

name: Boon: Shadow Step
description:
While next to a Totem, use Active Ability Button 1 to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all your Boons. Survivors within the Boon's range: Leave no Scratch Marks. Their Auras cannot be seen by the Killer.
When leaving the range, this ends after 2 / 3 / 4 s.
"Stick to the shadows and cover your tracks." -Mikaela Reid

name: Overcome
description:
Whenever you take damage: You retain your speed boost for 2 s longer. You gain Exhausted for 60 / 50 / 40 s.
"After careful analysis, we're getting the hell out of here!" -Jonah Vasquez

name: Corrective Action
description:
When the trial starts, you earn 1 / 2 / 3 Tokens, up to 5 .
Whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, earn 1 Token.
Whenever another Survivor misses a basic Skill Check, spend 1 Token: The missed Skill Check becomes a good Skill Check. You see that Survivor's Aura for 6 s.
"Can't hurt to have another set of eyes on the problem." -Jonah Vasquez

name: Boon: Exponential
description:
While next to a totem, use Active Ability Button 1 to bless it, creating a unique Boon totem that combines all your Boons.
Downed Survivors within the Boon's range: Recover 90 / 95 / 100 % faster. Can fully recover.
"It's not our time to die... probably." -Jonah Vasquez

name: Grim Embrace
description:
Whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, earn 1 Token.
When you move 16 m away from the hooked Survivor, all Generators are blocked for 6 / 8 / 10 s.
When you have 4 Tokens, when you move 16 m away from the hooked Survivor: All Generators are blocked for 40 s. You see the Obsession's Aura for 10 s.
"Are we nothing but prisoners to our sorrow?" -Carmina Mora

name: Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance
description:
When the trial starts: 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks. You earn 4 Tokens.
The first time each Survivor is hooked on a Scourge Hook, spend 1 Token, then the Generator with the most progress: Explodes, loses 10 / 15 / 20 % progress and starts regressing. Survivors repairing it scream.
"The pain spills beyond flesh/darkness staining the horizon." -Girl in the Shadow by Carmina Mora

name: Hex: Pentimento
description:
You see the Auras of cleansed Totems, and can rekindle each once.
Within 16 m, Survivors see the Auras of Rekindled Totems.
While a totem is rekindled, Survivors heal and repair 20 % slower, plus 1 / 2 / 3 % for each additional Rekindled Totem.
When all 5 Totems are rekindled at once, they are blocked.
“A pentimento is concealed art. There is often a desire to see that which is beyond." -A Guide to Art & Process

name: Parental Guidance
description: Whenever you stun the Killer, for 5 / 6 / 7 s: You make no Grunts of Pain. You leave no Pools of Blood. You leave no Scratch Marks.

name: Empathic Connection
description:
You heal other Survivors 25 / 30 / 35 % faster.
Injured Survivors see your Aura.

name: Boon: Dark Theory
description:
While next to a totem, use Active Ability Button 1 to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all your Boons.
Survivors within the Boon's range gain 3 % Haste . When leaving the range, this ends after 2 / 3 / 4 s.

name: Scourge Hook: Floods of Rage
description:
When the trial starts, 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.
Whenever a Survivor is unhooked from a Scourge Hook, you see the Auras of other Survivors for 5 / 6 / 7 s.

name: Call of Brine
description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, it regresses 30 / 40 / 50 % faster for 70 s.
For that time, whenever a Survivor hits a good basic Skill Check while repairing that Generator, you are alerted.

name: Merciless Storm
description: The first time each Generator has 90 % progress: Survivors repairing it get special Skill Checks. If they miss one of these or stop repairing, that Generator is blocked for 16 / 18 / 20 s.

name: Inner Focus
description:
Whenever the Killer damages another Survivor, you see the Killer's Aura for 6 / 8 / 10 s.
You see other Survivors' Scratch Marks.
"The death, the trauma, the fear… it all leads here. The Overlap." –Haddie Kaur, Ravages of the Abyss Episode 11

name: Residual Manifest
description:
Whenever you blind the Killer, they gain Blindness for 20 / 25 / 30 s.
You can rummage Chests 1 time. The first time you rummage a Chest, it will contain an uncommon Flashlight.
"I'll never see what Haddie sees. But so long as I'm with her, I know I'm safe." -Jordan Rois, Ravages of the Abyss Episode 5

name: Overzealous
description:
Whenever you bless or cleanse a Totem, until you take damage, you repair 8 / 9 / 10 % faster. If that Totem was a Hex Totem, the effect is doubled.
"The Ravage senses us. We need to work fast." -Haddie Kaur, Ravages of the Abyss Episode 9

name: Dissolution
description:
3 s after a Survivor takes damage, for 12 / 16 / 20 s, the next time a Survivor fast-vaults a Pallet while within your Terror Radius, it is destroyed.
"The Garden shall be a place of perfect Joy; through Joy, nothing shall stand in our way." –Otto Stamper

name: Darkness Revealed
description:
Whenever you search a Locker, you see the Auras of Survivors within 8 m of Lockers for 6 / 7 / 8 s. Cooldown: 30 s.
"Stay in the light, my children. In darkness, your fear will expose you." –Otto Stamper

name: Septic Touch
description:
While a Survivor within your Terror Radius is healing: They gain Blindness . They gain Exhausted .
When they stop healing, this ends after 20 / 25 / 30 s.
"Do not admit to fear, or pain, or doubt. These are the seeds from which darkness grows." –Otto Stamper

name: Shattered Hope
description:
Whenever you snuff a Boon Totem: You see the Auras of all Survivors within its range for 6 / 7 / 8 s. It is destroyed.
"Nothing is permanent here. Nothing except our endless perdition." -Unknown, Notebook

name: Wiretap
description:
After repairing 40 % of Generators, while next to a Generator, use Active Ability Button 2 to trap it for 100 / 110 / 120 s or until the Killer damages that Generator. All Survivors see that Generator's Aura for that time.
While the Killer is within 14 m of that Generator, all Survivors see the Killer's Aura.

name: Reactive Healing
description: While injured, whenever another Survivor within 32 m of you takes damage, you gain 40 / 45 / 50 % missing healing progress.

name: Low Profile
description: When all other Survivors are downed or hooked, for 70 / 80 / 90 s: You make no Grunts of Pain. You leave no Pools of Blood. You leave no Scratch Marks.

name: Better Than New
description: Whenever you finish healing another Survivor, until they take damage: They bless and cleanse 12 / 14 / 16 % faster. They heal 12 / 14 / 16 % faster. They unlock Chests 12 / 14 / 16 % faster.

name: Reassurance
description: Once per Hook State, while within 6 m of a hooked Survivor, use Active Ability Button 2 to stop the sacrifice progress for 20 / 25 / 30 s.

name: Hyperfocus
description:
Whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, you earn 1 Token, up to 6 .
For each Token, basic Skill Checks: Appear 4 % more often. Spin 4 % faster. Whenever you hit a great, give 10 / 20 / 30 % more progress.
Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, hit a good Skill Check, or stop healing or repairing, lose all Tokens.

name: Superior Anatomy
description: Whenever a Survivor fast-vaults within 12 m of you, the next time you basic-vault a window, it is 30 / 35 / 40 % faster. Cooldown: 25 s.

name: Awakened Awareness
description: While carrying a Survivor, within 16 / 18 / 20 m of you, you see the Auras of other Survivors.

name: Terminus
description:
When all Generators are completed: all injured, downed, and hooked Survivors gain Broken .
When an Exit Gate is opened, this ends after 35 / 40 / 45 s.

name: Potential Energy
description:
While repairing, use Active Ability Button 2 to earn Tokens instead of progress, up to 10 / 15 / 20 Tokens.
While you have at least 1 Token, Active Ability Button 2 to spend all Tokens and gain 1 % progress for each Token spent.
Whenever you take damage, lose all Tokens.
"When you look a layer deeper, you realize… everything is connected." - Vittorio Toscano

name: Fogwise
description:
While repairing, whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, you see the Killer's Aura for 4 / 5 / 6 s.
"I have seen great cruelty… and I have also seen another way. " - Vittorio Toscano

name: Quick Gambit
description:
While chased by the Killer: You see the Auras of other Survivors. Other Survivors repair 3 / 4 / 5 % faster.
Whenever you take damage, cooldown: 40 s.
"We need not resort to violence. And I shall prove it." - Vittorio Toscano

name: Nowhere to Hide
description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, for 3 / 4 / 5 s, you see the Auras of Survivors within 24 m of you.
"Out with you, cowards! Show yourselves!" - Tarhos Kovács

name: Hex: Face the Darkness
description:
Whenever you damage a Survivor, they are hexed and a Dull Totem ignites.
Every 35 / 30 / 25 s, other Survivors not within your Terror Radius scream, then you see their Auras for 2 s.
When the hexed Survivor is downed or becomes healthy, the Hex Totem is extinguished.
"I shall make an example of one. These mewling worms will never know peace."- Tarhos Kovács

name: Hubris
description:
Whenever you are stunned by a Survivor, they gain Exposed for 20 / 25 / 30 s. Cooldown: 20 s.
"You have made a grave mistake, standing in opposition to me this day." - Tarhos Kovács

name: Cut Loose
description:
While chased by the Killer, whenever you medium or fast-vault: For up to 4 / 5 / 6 s, your medium and fast vaults are silent. During that time, whenever you medium or fast-vault, the timer is reset.
Cooldown: 45 s.
“I know how we can get out of here. Quick, this way.” –Thalita Lyra

name: Friendly Competition
description:
Whenever you finish repairing a Generator with at least 1 other Survivor, Survivors who finished repairing it repair 5 % faster for 100 / 110 / 120 s.
“C'mon, let's do this.” –Thalita Lyra

name: Teamwork: Power of Two
description:
Whenever you finish healing another Survivor, while you stay within 8 / 12 / 16 m of each other, you both gain 5 % Haste . When either of you leaves the range, this ends after 4 s.
“You good? Then keep up.” –Thalita Lyra

name: Background Player
description:
Whenever the Killer picks-up another Survivor, for the next 10 s, when you start running: Gain 50 % Haste for 5 s. Gain Exhausted for 30 / 25 / 20 s.
“You forget about me?” –Renato Lyra

name: Blood Rush
description:
Until all Generators are completed, whenever you are unhooked, for the next 40 / 50 / 60 s, while Exhausted , use Active Ability Button 1 to lose Exhausted instantly.
This is disabled by conspicuous actions.
“Just gotta… push through.” –Renato Lyra

name: Teamwork: Collective Stealth
description:
Whenever another Survivor finishes healing you, while within 8 / 12 / 16 m of each other, you both leave no Scratch Marks. When either of you leaves the range, this ends after 4 s.
“I'm good, I'm good… but keep it down.” –Renato Lyra

name: Game Afoot
description:
While chasing the Obsession, whenever you basic-break Pallets or Breakable Walls, or damage Generators, you gain 7 % Haste for 8 / 9 / 10 s.
Whenever you damage the Survivor with the most chase time with a basic-attack, they become the Obsession.
“This one might actually be a challenge... ” -Adriana Imai

name: THWACK!
description:
When the trial starts, you earn 3 Tokens, up to 3 .
Whenever you hook a Survivor, you earn 1 Token.
Whenever you break a Pallet or Breakable Wall, spend 1 Token. Then, all Survivors within 36 m scream and you see their Auras for 4 / 5 / 6 s.
“All those who stood in her path feared her mighty THWACK!” –Sonhadores Sombrios, Issue #3

name: Leverage
description:
Whenever a Survivor unhooks another or themselves, they heal 20 / 25 / 30 % slower for 60 s.
“Good. Now we can move in for the kill.” -Adriana Imai

name: Troubleshooter
description:
While chased by the Killer: You see the Aura of the Generator with the most progress. Whenever you drop a Pallet, you see the Killer's Aura for 4 / 5 / 6 s.
When the Killer stops chasing you, this ends after 6 / 8 / 10 s.
“Nothing gets done around here if I don't do it.” –Gabriel Soma

name: Made for This
description:
While injured, whenever you finish healing another Survivor, you gain Endurance for 6 / 8 / 10 s.
While you have Deep Wound, you gain 3 % Haste .
“I didn't come here to be robot food.” –Gabriel Soma

name: Scavenger
description:
While repairing and while your Toolbox is empty, whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, you earn 1 Token.
When you have 5 Tokens, spend them all: Your Toolbox is recharged instantly. You repair 50 % slower for 40 / 35 / 30 s.
You can rummage Chests 1 time. The first time you rummage a Chest, it will contain an uncommon Toolbox.
“It's amazing what people will throw away around here.” –Gabriel Soma

name: Genetic Limits
description:
Whenever a Survivor takes damage, they gain Exhausted for 6 / 7 / 8 s.
“THE ORGANIC BODY IS SO LIMITED.” –HUX-A7-13

name: Forced Hesitation
description:
Whenever you down a Survivor, other Survivors within 16 m of the downed Survivor gain 20 % Hindered for 10 s. Cooldown: 40 / 35 / 30 s.
“THE ORGANIC MIND'S CAPACITY FOR EMPATHY GOES BEYOND HINDRANCE.” –HUX-A7-13

name: Machine Learning
description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, it becomes compromised.
When that Generator is completed by Survivors: You gain 8 % Haste for 40 / 50 / 60 s. You gain Undetectable for 40 / 50 / 60 s.
Only one Generator can be compromised at a time.
“YOU WILL HOLD NO DOMINION OVER ME.” –HUX-A7-13

name: Dramaturgy
description:
While healthy and running, use Active Ability Button 1 : You gain 25 % Haste for 2 s. You gain Exhausted for 60 / 50 / 40 s.
Then, one happens at random: You gain 25 % Haste for 2 s. You gain Exposed for 12 s. You gain a random rare item with random add-ons. You scream, but nothing happens.
The same effect cannot happen twice in a row.
“Take the part. It's a good movie, he says. What's the worst that can happen?” –Nicolas Cage

name: Scene Partner
description:
While you are within the Killer's Terror Radius, whenever you look at them: Scream, then see the Killer's Aura for 4 / 5 / 6 s. There is a 50 % chance you will scream again.If you do, you see the Killer's Aura for 2 s more.
Cooldown: 40 s.
“This is not in the script!” –Nicolas Cage

name: Plot Twist
description:
While injured, crouched and idle, use Active Ability Button 2 to be downed silently.
While downed this way, once per trial: You make no Grunts of Pain. You leave no Pools of Blood. You recover 25 % faster. You can fully recover.
Whenever you recover this way: You gain 50 % Haste for 2 / 3 / 4 s. You are healed instantly.
When all Generators are completed, you can use this ability once again.
“I think you'll find this shooting location… captivating.” –Pauline Stamper

name: Ultimate Weapon
description:
Whenever you search a Locker, Survivors within 40 m: Gain Blindness for 30 s. Scream.
Cooldown: 55 / 50 / 45 s.
“I can't lie to you about your chances, but... you have my sympathies.” –Ash

name: Rapid Brutality
description:
Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic-attack, you gain 5 % Haste for 8 / 9 / 10 s.
While chasing a Survivor, you cannot gain Bloodlust.
“Catch it, put it in the airlock, get rid of it.” –Dallas

name: Alien Instinct
description:
Whenever you hook a Survivor, the farthest injured Survivor: Gains Oblivious for 40 / 50 / 60 s. You see their Aura for 8 s.
“Yellow light's for my eyes only.” –Dallas

name: Lucky Star
description:
While hiding in a Locker, you make no Grunts of Pain.
Whenever you exit a Locker, for 30 s: You see the Aura of the closest Generator. You see the Auras of other Survivors. You make no Grunts of Pain. You leave no Pools of Blood.
Cooldown: 35 / 30 / 25 s.
“You are my… lucky star…” –Ellen Ripley

name: Chemical Trap
description:
After repairing 20 % of Generators, while next to a Dropped Pallet, use Active Ability Button 2 to trap it for 40 / 50 / 60 s. All Survivors see that Pallet's Aura for that time.
When the Killer breaks that Pallet, the trap explodes and they gain 50 % Hindered for 4 s.
“How do we kill it, Ash?” –Ellen Ripley

name: Light-footed
description:
While healthy and running, your footsteps are silent to the Killer.
Whenever you do a fast-action, cooldown: 14 / 12 / 10 s.
“Come on, cat.” –Ellen Ripley

name: Hex: Two Can Play
description:
While this Hex is dull, each time you are blinded or stunned by a Survivor 4 / 3 / 2 times, a Dull Totem ignites.
Whenever you are blinded or stunned by a Survivor you are not carrying, they are blinded for 1.5 s.
“From now on, no more Mr. Good Guy.” -Chucky

name: Friends 'Til the End
description:
You will kill anyone who gets between you and your target.
When you hook any Survivors that is not the ***Obsession***, the following effects apply to the ***Obsession***:
* Their Aura is revealed for **6**/**8**/**10** **seconds**.
* They suffer from the ***Exposed*** **Status Effect** for **20 seconds**.
When you hook the ***Obsession***, the following effects apply to a random Survivor:
* Causes the Survivor to scream and reveal their location to the Killer.
* They become the new ***Obsession***.
*You can only be **obsessed** with one Survivor at a time.*
*"I got some fresh meat lined up, and I'm not gonna let you spoil it, not this time!" — Chucky*

name: Batteries Included
description:
Within 16 m of a completed Generator, you gain 5 % Haste . When you leave the range, this ends after 1 / 3 / 5 s.
“Surprise! Did you miss me, Andy?” -Chucky

name: Champion of Light
description:
While you are using a Flashlight, you gain 50 % Haste .
Whenever you blind the Killer, they gain 20 % Hindered for 6 s. Cooldown: 60 / 50 / 40 s.
“I squeezed the flashlight like my life depended on it, willing it to stop coming any closer.” – Departure

name: Boon: Illumination
description:
While next to a totem, use Active Ability Button 1 to bless it, creating a unique Boon totem that combines all your Boons.
Survivors within the Boon's range: See the Auras of Chests. See the Auras of Generators.
While you have a Boon Totem, you bless and cleanse 6 / 8 / 10 % faster.
"A shift in reality. Heavy with hidden meanings." – Return

name: Deadline
description:
While injured, basic Skill Checks: Are 6 / 8 / 10 % more likely to appear. Appear in random places.
Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, you lose 50 % less progress.
“The night had been one desperate situation after another.” – Departure

name: Unbound
description:
Whenever a healthy Survivor becomes injured, for the next 24 / 27 / 30 s, whenever you basic-vault a window, gain 7 % Haste for 10 s.
"I heard it. Running. It was getting closer!” -Anonymous Testimony, 09/09/1979

name: Unforeseen
description:
Whenever you damage a Generator: Your Terror Radius is set to that Generator for 22 / 26 / 30 s and its radius is 32 m. You gain Undetectable for that time.
Cooldown: 30 s.
"Mom, if you find this, I'm sorry...” - Final Journal Entry, 07/12/1991

name: Undone
description:
Whenever a Survivor misses a basic Skill Check, earn 3 Tokens, up to 18 / 24 / 30 .
Whenever you damage a Generator, spend all Tokens. For each Token spent: The Generator loses 1 % progress. The Generator is blocked for 1 s.
When that Generator is unblocked, it begins regressing. Cooldown: 60 s.
"Erratic behavior in machinery could be related to [REDACTED], further testing required.” - OSS Report, 12/02/1943

name: Invocation: Weaving Spiders
description:
While in the Basement next to the circle, use Active Ability Button 1 to invoke. While invoking, other Survivors see your Aura and can join your Invocation.
When the Invocation is completed: All Generators gain 8 / 9 / 10 permanent charges. You become injured. You gain Broken .
Each Invocation can only be completed once per trial.
"I call upon the spirits of the night, to aid us in our desperate flight!" -Sable

name: Strength in Shadows
description:
While in the Basement: You can heal yourself, but 30 % slower. Whenever you finish healing, you see the Killer's Aura for 6 / 8 / 10 s.
"I'm getting out of here, if it's the last thing I do.” -Sable

name: Wicked
description:
While in the Basement, you can unhook yourself.
Whenever you are unhooked, you see the Killer's Aura for 16 / 18 / 20 s.
“I haven't let anyone get in my way before. You think I'm gonna start now?” -Sable

name: Weave Attunement
description:
The first time each item is depleted, it is dropped.
While a Survivor is within 12 m of a dropped item: You see their Aura. They see the item's Aura.
Whenever a Survivor picks-up an item, they gain Oblivious for 20 / 25 / 30 s.
“No number of novelties will protect you from me!” - Vecna

name: Languid Touch
description:
Whenever a Survivor within 36 m of you scares a Crow, they gain Exhausted for 6 / 8 / 10 s. Cooldown: 5 s.
“Submit to me. It is inevitable.” - Vecna

name: Dark Arrogance
description:
You basic-vault Windows 15 / 20 / 25 % faster.
Whenever you are blinded or Pallet-stunned, the duration is 15 % longer.
“Run all you want. I will not be denied.” - Vecna

name: Mirrored Illusion
description:
After repairing 20 % of Generators, while next to a Chest, Exit Gate Switch, Generator, or Totem, use Active Ability Button 2 to create a static illusion for 40 / 50 / 60 s.
"Just... stay there... perfect!" -Baermar

name: Bardic Inspiration
description:
While idle, use Active Ability Button 1 to perform, empowering all Survivors within 16 m for up to 15 s. While you are performing, other Survivors will see your Aura. Roll a d20: 1 | You scream, but nothing happens. 2-10 | Basic Skill Checks give + 1 % progress. 11-19 | Basic Skill Checks give + 2 % progress. 20 | Basic Skill Checks give + 3 % progress.
If you complete the performance, this effect ends after 90 s. Cooldown: 110 / 100 / 90 s.
"Listen closely! I'm about to save your life!" -Aestri

name: Still Sight
description:
After being idle for 4 / 3 / 2 s, within 24 m, until you start moving: You see the Killer's Aura. You see the Auras of Chests. You see the Auras of Generators.
"Breathe in. Breathe out. Now open your eyes." -Baermar

name: Finesse
description:
While healthy, you fast-vault 20 % faster.
Whenever you fast-vault, cooldown: 40 / 35 / 30 s.
"Just need to push myself a bit further." -Lara Croft

name: Hardened
description:
When you have blessed or cleansed a Totem and unlocked a Chest, whenever you would scream, you see the Killer's Aura for 3 / 4 / 5 s instead.
"Got to keep quiet. That thing is still out there." -Lara Croft

name: Specialist
description:
Whenever you rummage or unlock a Chest, you earn 1 Token, up to 6 .
While repairing a Generator, whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, spend all Tokens. For each Token spent, the Generator gains 2 / 3 / 4 % permanent progress.
"Well, then. Doesn't this feel familiar?" -Lara Croft

name: Hex: Wretched Fate
description:
The first time a Generator is completed, a Dull Totem ignites.
The Obsession: Repairs 27 / 30 / 33 % slower. Sees the Hex Totem's Aura within 12 m.
"So toil, mortal, toil! Your effort will be for naught!" - Dracula

name: Human Greed
description:
Whenever a Survivor gets within 8 m of a locked Chest, you see their Aura for 3 / 4 / 5 s.
You can lock unlocked Chests. Cooldown: 10 s.
You see the Auras of locked Chests.
"Come running, one and all, and see what fortune awaits you." - Dracula

name: Dominance
description:
The first time each Chest is being unlocked and each Totem is being blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, it is blocked for 8 / 12 / 16 s.
"Tragic, is it not? How powerless you must feel." -Dracula

name: Eyes of Belmont
description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, you see the Killer's Aura for 1 / 2 / 3 s.
Whenever you see the Killer's Aura for a duration, it is 2 s longer.
"Ha! Your secret has been revealed!"  -Trevor

name: Exultation
description:
Whenever you Pallet-stun the Killer: Your item rarity is upgraded to the next tier, if possible. If the item was upgraded, it recharges 75 % Charges.
Cooldown: 30 / 25 / 20 s.
"You will not take me this day!" -Trevor

name: Moment of Glory
description:
After you rummage or unlock 2 Chests, while not Broken , when you become injured, gain Broken .
After 80 / 70 / 60 s, if you are not downed, you are instantly healed.
"Never lose hope for a brighter tomorrow." -Trevor

name: All-Shaking Thunder
description:
Whenever you fall from at least 1.25 m, your lunge-attacks are 75 % longer for 15 / 20 / 25 s. Cooldown: 5 s.
"Go on. Run. Tell your friends I'm coming for them." -Portia Maye

name: Scourge Hook: Jagged Compass
description:
When the trial starts, 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.
Whenever a Survivor is unhooked, the Hook becomes a Scourge Hook.
Whenever you hook a Survivor on a Scourge Hook, for 6 / 8 / 10 s, you see the Aura of the Generator with the most progress.
"Drop anchor! I will chart us a new course." -Portia Maye

name: No Quarter
description:
While self-healing, whenever a Survivor has 75 % progress, they get special Skill Checks. If they miss one of these or stop healing, they gain Broken for 20 / 25 / 30 s.
"Fire another broadside! Don't stop until the sea takes them!" -Portia Maye

name: Invocation: Treacherous Crows
description:
While in the Basement next to the circle, use Active Ability Button 2 to invoke. While invoking, other Survivors see your Aura and can join your Invocation.
When the Invocation is completed: Whenever the Killer scares a Crow while a Survivor is in their Terror Radius, all Survivors see the Killer's Aura for 1 / 1.5 / 2 s. You become injured. You gain Broken .
Each Invocation can only be completed once per trial.
"Remember your training. They taught you all about the crows." -Taurie Cain

name: Clean Break
description:
Whenever you finish healing another Survivor, while being healed by another Survivor, use Active Ability Button 1 to gain Broken .
After 80 / 70 / 60 s, if you are not downed, you are instantly healed.
"I'll be fine! Don't stick your neck out for me." -Taurie Cain

name: Shoulder the Burden
description:
Once per trial, while you do not have 2 Hook States and are next to a hooked Survivor, use Active Ability Button 2 to unhook them: They lose 1 Hook State. You gain 1 Hook State. You scream. You gain Exposed for 60 / 50 / 40 s.
"It's not your time yet. Now go on!" -Taurie Cain

name: Hex: Nothing But Misery
description:
After you damage Survivors with a basic-attack 8 times, a Dull Totem ignites.
Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic-attack, they gain 5 % Hindered for 10 / 12.5 / 15 s.
"All of the liabilities of this world are due to the inadequacies of the person involved." -Ken Kaneki

name: Forever Entwined
description:
Whenever a Survivor takes damage, you earn 1 Token, up to 6 / 7 / 8 .
For each Token: You hook Survivors 4 % faster. You pick-up and drop Survivors 4 % faster.
"You tried to devour me so you have no room to complain if I eat you, do you?" -Ken Kaneki

name: None Are Free
description:
The first time you hook each Survivor, earn 1 Token.
When all Generators are completed, for each Token: Upright Pallets are blocked for 12 / 14 / 16 s. Windows are blocked for 12 / 14 / 16 s.
"I'm not wrong. What's wrong is this messed-up world!" -Ken Kaneki

name: Do No Harm
description:
While healing another Survivor: For each Hook State they have, you heal 30 / 40 / 50 % faster. Whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, you gain 3 % more progress.
"Look at me. My name's Orela, and I'm gonna make sure you're all right." -Orela Rose

name: Duty of Care
description:
While healthy, whenever you take a protection hit, other Survivors within 12 m gain 25 % Haste for 4 / 5 / 6 s.
"Don't worry about me. I've got a knack for bouncing back." -Orela Rose

name: Rapid Response
description:
Whenever you fast-exit a Locker, you gain Exhausted for 30 / 25 / 20 s.
Whenever you gain Exhausted , you see the Killer's Aura for 2 s.
"All right. You got this. 3... 2... 1... go!" -Orela Rose

name: Help Wanted
description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, it is compromised.
When that Generator is completed by Survivors, your basic-attack cooldowns are 25 % shorter for 40 / 50 / 60 s.
Only 1 Generator can be compromised at a time.
"You only think you are in control..." -Springtrap

name: Phantom Fear
description:
Whenever a Survivor within your Terror Radius looks at you, they scream, then you see their Aura for 2 s. Cooldown: 80 / 70 / 60 s.
"Excellent. Your screams please me." -Springtrap

name: Haywire
description:
Exit Gate Switches with at least 80 % progress regress at 80 / 90 / 100 % speed.
While they are regressing, Survivors see the Exit Gate Lights flicker randomly.
"There will be no redemption for you." -Springtrap

name: Apocalyptic Ingenuity
description:
After you rummage or unlock 2 Chests, while next to a Broken Pallet, use Active Ability Button 1 for 4 s to create a Fragile Pallet.
Within 24 / 28 / 32 m, you see the Auras of Broken Pallets.
“Without the fences, this place is worthless.” -Rick Grimes

name: Come and Get Me!
description:
Whenever you unhook a Survivor, while crouched and idle, use Active Ability Button 1 to have injured and downed Survivors within 24 m: Make no Grunts of Pain for 10 / 12.5 / 15 s. Leave no Pools of Blood for 10 / 12.5 / 15 s. Leave no Scratch Marks for 10 / 12.5 / 15 s.
You scream, then the Killer sees your Aura for 5 s.
“We're the ones who live.” -Rick Grimes

name: Teamwork: Toughen Up
description:
While injured, whenever another Survivor within 24 m of you blinds or Pallet-stuns the Killer, for 20 / 25 / 30 s: You make no Grunts of Pain. You leave no Pools of Blood. You leave no Scratch Marks.
“They're fucking with the wrong people.” -Rick Grimes

name: Conviction
description:
After you finish healing 1 other Survivor, while downed with at least 25 % recovery, use Active Ability Button 1 to recover instantly.
You gain Broken , then, after 20 / 25 / 30 s, you are downed instantly.
"It's enough to keep going. Keep trying. Keep fighting. Keep dreaming." -Michonne Grimes

name: Last Stand
description:
After hiding for 120 / 105 / 90 s within the Killer's Terror Radius, when you fast-vault, once per trial, stun the Killer for 3 s if they are within 2.5 m.
"Some bullies, you can live with. Others, you gotta fight." - Michonne Grimes

name: Teamwork: Throw Down
description:
Whenever you blind or Pallet-stun the Killer, for 6 / 8 / 10 s, other injured Survivors within 24 m: Gain Endurance . See the Killer's Aura.
"Facing evil brings good people together." -Michonne Grimes

name: Road Life
description:
While injured, not Broken and repairing a Generator: Whenever you hit a basic great Skill Check, you earn 1 Token. Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, you lose 1 token.
When you have 6 / 5 / 4 Tokens, spend all Tokens to heal 100 % faster until you stop healing.
“Remind me to teach you how to patch your own pedals, Krit.” -Vee Boonyasak

name: ONE-TWO-THREE-FOUR!
description:
While idle, use Active Ability Button 2 to perform, empowering all Survivors within 16 m for up to 15 s. While you are performing, other Survivors will see your Aura. You get special Skill Checks during that time: while healing or repairing, basic Skill Checks are 20 % more likely to appear.
If you complete the performance, the effect ends after 90 s. Cooldown: 110 / 100 / 90 s.
“We are loud! We are heavy! WE ARE AXEKICK!” - Vee Boonyasak

name: Ghost Notes
description:
While you have Exhausted , your Scratch Marks disappear 50 % faster.
You lose Exhausted 5 / 7.5 / 10 % faster.
“Let's take it to the bridge!” -Vee Boonyasak

name: Ravenous
description:
The first time you hook each Survivor, you earn 1 Token.
