When you have 4 Tokens, all Survivors: Scream. Gain Exposed for 40 / 50 / 60 s.
“Weeping Ginevra's blood streams/The devil smells the weak.” -Fabbro Barone's Ginevra

name: Wandering Eye
description:
Whenever you start chasing a Survivor, for the next 5 s, you see the Auras of all other injured Survivors within 20 m. Cooldown: 40 / 35 / 30 s.
“A drop does not satiate/when a river is needed.” -Elliot Campbell's Grandeur of Samuel

name: Hex: Overture of Doom
description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites and hexes the farthest Generator from it.
After a Survivor repairs the hexed Generator for 5 seconds: You gain Undetectable for 20 / 25 / 30 s. For that time, your Terror Radius is set to that Generator.
When the hexed Generator is repaired, the next farthest Generator is hexed.
“From salvation's ruin, be warned/death comes from all around.” -Giovanni Serrata's Fog Hill

name: Bada Bada Boom
description:
After repairing 20 % of Generators, while next to a Window, use Active Ability Button 2 to trap it for 40 / 50 / 60 s. All Survivors see that Window's Aura for that time.
When the Killer vaults that Window, the trap explodes and they gain 50 % Hindered for 6 s.
"Never tell me the odds." -Dustin Henderson

name: Change of Plan
description:
When the trial starts, you earn 2 Tokens.
While hiding in a Locker and holding a non-event Toolbox, use Active Ability Button 2 and spend 1 Token to transform your Toolbox and add-ons into a Med-Kit of the same rarity with 80 / 90 / 100 % Charges and random add-ons of the same rarity.
“Oh my god, oh my god, oh my god, oh my god.” —Dustin Henderson

name: Teamwork: Full Circuit
description:
For each other Survivor repairing a Generator with you, good basic Skill Check zones are 15 / 20 / 25 % bigger.
While repairing with at least 1 other Survivor, you repair 5 % faster.
“How many times do I have to be right on the money before you guys just trust me?” —Dustin Henderson

name: Extrasensory Perception
description:
After crouching for 4 s: You see Auras in an expanding radius up to 44 m. You gain Elusive . You gain Oblivious .
When you stop crouching, or after 11 s, cooldown: 60 / 50 / 40 s.
"What is friend?" —Eleven

name: We See You
description:
Whenever the Killer sees your Aura, you earn 1 Token. Cooldown: 10 s.
When you have 4 Tokens, spend them all. Then, all Survivors see the Killer's Aura for 10 / 12.5 / 15 s.
“It is not me. It is you. You are the monster.” —Eleven

name: Teamwork: Soft-Spoken
description:
For each other Survivor repairing a Generator with you, the range of Generator repair noises is 15 / 20 / 25 % smaller.
While repairing with at least 1 other Survivor, you repair 5 % faster.
"I make my own rules." —Eleven

name: Turn Back The Clock
description:
After hooking a Survivor, for the next 40 / 50 / 60 s, use Active Ability Button 1 to make target Generator you can see within 20 m explode, lose 10 % progress and start regressing.
“Nothing will happen to you... Nothing that you don't deserve!” -Henry Creel

name: Secret Project
description:
Whenever a totem is blessed or cleansed, a random unblocked Generator is blocked for 20 / 25 / 30 s.
Whenever 1 or more Generators are blocked, you gain Undetectable for 30 s.
“You are a prisoner here, just like me.” -Henry Creel

name: Hex: Hive Mind
description:
The first time you hook a Survivor, a Dull Totem ignites.
The Auras of Generators show their progress.
When 1 Generator remains: All Generators explode, lose 6 / 8 / 10 % progress and start regressing. The Hex Totem is extinguished.
“You... let us in. And now, you are going to have to let us stay.” -Henry Creel

name: Flow State
description:
Whenever a generator is completed, earn 1 Token, up to 5 .
For each Token: You bless and cleanse 8 / 9 / 10 % faster. You heal 8 / 9 / 10 % faster. You unhook Survivors 8 / 9 / 10 % faster.
“I'm sorry… I didn't realize I was working so late.” – Kwon Tae-young

name: A Place For Us
description:
While healing another Survivor, you both gain Elusive .
Whenever you finish healing the Obsession, you both gain Elusive for 20 / 25 / 30 s.
When the trial starts, you are less likely to be the Obsession.
“I understand computers… systems. Problems. But this… I wonder if I'll ever understand.” – Kwon Tae-young

name: Five Moves Ahead
description:
While you are in the Killer's Terror Radius or chased by the Killer: You see the Auras of the 5 closest Pallets and Windows. After you drop a Pallet, you start moving 50 % earlier. Whenever you drop a Pallet, cooldown: 40 / 35 / 30 s.
“Every problem has a solution. It's only a question of complexity.” – Kwon Tae-young

name: Hex: Scared to Death
description:
After you hook 3 different Survivors, a Dull Totem ignites.
While chasing a Survivor, whenever you basic-break a Pallet, Survivors within 13 m: Scream. Gain 11 / 12 / 13 % Hindered for 3 s.
"There was a scream from the forest. Like someone was attacking her." -Mount Ormond Missing Person Report

name: Silent Shadow
description:
Whenever you hook a Survivor, you gain Undetectable for 11 / 12 / 13 s.
When all Generators are completed, you gain Undetectable .
“Did you see him or not? I can't put out an APB for a bad feeling.” -Sgt. Reyes, Greenville Police

name: Rampage
description:
Whenever you basic-break a Pallet or Breakable Wall, you earn 1 Token, up to 13 .
Whenever you are blinded or Pallet-stunned, for the next 13 s you gain 1 % Haste for each Token. Cooldown: 30 / 25 / 20 .
“Signs of a pursuit led deep into the woods where the victim's body was found.” -Port Henly Herald

name: Wide Open Throttle
description:
Whenever you fast-vault a Pallet: You gain 10 / 12.5 / 15 % Haste for 3 s. The Pallet is reset, blocked for 60 s, and all Survivors see its Aura for that time.
Cooldown: 60 s.
"Nothing but the open road. Just the way I like it." -Shane Wiigwaas

name: Lend a Hand
description:
Whenever you bless or cleanse 1 Totem, while healing another Survivor and only once per Survivor, use Active Ability Button 2 to give them 2 / 3 / 4 permanent healing charges.
"Walk it off, will you? We still have work to do." -Shane Wiigwaas

name: Cross-Examination
description:
While in the Killer's Terror Radius and not being chased by the Killer, they leave Light Marks that last for 10 s that you can see. While on the Killer's Light Marks, you gain Elusive . This ends after 3 / 4 / 5 s.
"The witness has said enough, Your Honor. No further questions." -Shane Wiigwaas

name: Fruits of Your Labor
description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, you earn 1 Token.
Whenever you finish repairing a Generator, for each Token: You gain 5 % Haste for 2 s. You gain 10 / 15 / 20 % healing progress.

name: Salvation's Cry
description: Whenever the Killer starts chasing you: You see the Auras of other Survivors for 1 / 2 / 3 s. Survivors not being chased see your Aura for 5 s. Survivors not being chased see the Killer's Aura for 5 s.

name: Boon: Steadfast
description:
While next to a Totem, use Active Ability Button 1 to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all your Boons.
Generators within the Boon's range: Regress 50 % slower. Survivors repair them 8 / 9 / 10 % faster.
Survivors within the Boon's range see the Auras of affected Generators.

name: Celestial Witness
description: Every 30 s, if the Obsession is at least 40 m away from you, you see their Aura for 2 / 2.5 / 3 s. Otherwise, the farthest Survivor becomes the Obsession.

name: Hex: Under Your Thumb
description:
The first time a Survivor gains a hook state, a Dull Totem ignites.
Whenever a running Survivor gains Haste within 32 m of you, you are alerted.
Running Survivors cannot gain more than 25 / 20 / 15 % Haste at a time.

name: Lay Waste
description: Whenever you damage a Generator, for each Charge it has, it regresses 2 % faster. Cooldown: 55 / 50 / 45 s.
